name.en: Universiti Malaya (Faculty of Business and Economics)
name.zh: 马来亚大学（商业与经济学院）

program.en: Bachelor of Business Administration (3.5 years, 7 semesters)
program.zh: 工商管理学士（3.5 年，共 7 个学期）

label.en: Tuition, international student: RM 77,100 for the whole programme (excl. 6% SST), spread over 7 semesters
label.zh: 国际生学费：全程 RM 77,100（不含 6% 销售与服务税），按 7 个学期平摊

label.en: UM residential college room, per semester (quadruple to twin room; incl. utilities and WiFi)
label.zh: 马大住宿学院，每学期（四人间至双人间，含水电和网络）

label.en: LRT/MRT, buses and occasional Grab rides
label.zh: 轻轨/地铁、公交及偶尔打车（Grab）

label.en: Compulsory international student medical insurance (may be included in the visa processing fee)
label.zh: 国际生强制医疗保险（可能已含在签证处理费中）

label.en: UM international student processing fee, 3-year student visa (China; includes the Multiple Entry Visa fee)
label.zh: 马大国际生签证处理费，3 年学生签证（中国籍，已含多次入境签证费）

label.en: Return flight China-Kuala Lumpur, once a year
label.zh: 中国往返吉隆坡机票（每年一次）

label.en: Bedding, daily items and first-week costs
label.zh: 床品、日用品及入住首周开销
学费税费（适用金额待确认）
超过三年的签证续签费用

note.zh: 吉隆坡校区中央图书馆。

note.zh: 校内体育场、游泳池和球场。

note.zh: 收藏亚洲陶瓷与艺术的大学博物馆。

note.en: Malay, Chinese and Indian rice dishes on campus.
note.zh: 校内马来、中式和印度饭食。

sources.title: Universiti Malaya - Bachelor of Business Administration (fees, intake)
UM - International student processing fees by country (updated 10 July 2026)

notes.en: The programme runs 3.5 years (7 semesters). The RM 77,100 international tuition total is allocated across 7 semesters; the school excludes 6% SST. Tax scope and visa renewal cost need confirmation.
notes.zh: 学制 3.5 年共 7 学期；国际生全程学费 RM 77,100 按 7 学期分摊。学校注明不含 6% SST；税费范围及签证续签费用待确认。

notes.en: The programme is 3.5 years (7 semesters), rounded up to 4 years here, so a 4-year plan counts one semester too many; RM 77,100 is the whole-programme international fee, shown per semester.
notes.zh: 学制 3.5 年（7 个学期），此处按 4 年计，4 年计划会多算一个学期；RM 77,100 为国际生全程学费，此处按学期平摊显示。

notes.en: Intakes are October (Semester 1) and March (Semester 2). October 2027 dates are projected; the 2027/28 calendar was not found.
notes.zh: 每年 10 月（第一学期）和 3 月（第二学期）入学；2027 年 10 月的日期为推算，未找到 2027/28 校历。

notes.en: The processing fee PDF lists China at RM 30 MEV, RM 5,461 (1-year visa) and RM 6,181 (3-year visa); the visa prices already include the MEV fee. A 3-year visa does not cover a 3.5-year programme, so expect a renewal. Confirm what the package includes (EMGS, insurance).
notes.zh: 签证处理费 PDF 中国籍一栏：MEV RM 30、1 年签证 RM 5,461、3 年签证 RM 6,181，签证价格已含 MEV 费用。3 年签证不足以覆盖 3.5 年学制，预计需续签。请确认套餐所含内容（EMGS、保险等）。

notes.en: College room rates are the published undergraduate rates; places for international students are not guaranteed.
notes.zh: 住宿学院价格为公布的本科生标准，国际生床位不保证。
